result.reason: The operative redline does not add any aggregate liability cap and deletes the indemnification carve-out, which is required even under the fallback. It also lacks carve-outs for gross negligence and wilful misconduct and does not address payment obligations. The margin comment cannot cure these operative defects and itself proposes narrower/different carve-outs than the playbook. Although the mutual consequential-damages exclusion remains, the deletion materially weakens required protection and is not a necessary change.
